close_reason: resolved: all *changes handlers delegate to generic handle_changes (JMAP-63k)
description: jmap-server/handlers.rs exports handle_changes<O,B>. chat.rs, space.rs, message.rs, mailbox.rs, thread.rs, identity.rs, submission.rs each re-implement the identical 25-line changes pattern. Only Mailbox/changes and Chat/changes include updatedProperties (the ones that copy the generic), the others omit it (the P0 bugs JMAP-4ii.3/4/5). The root cause is that domain handlers do not delegate to handle_changes. If they did, the RFC requirement would be met automatically. All /changes handlers with no domain-specific logic should call handle_changes<O,B>(backend, args).await.
title: Cross-crate divergence: /changes handlers not reusing generic handle_changes
